description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the task data structure (tasks.json at .tasks/tasks.json) and required JSON schema fields (id, name, description, type, priority, status, created_at, due_date, decomposed, progress, last_updated, blocked_by, depends_on, tags). 2. Agent updates TSK-20260310-001: marks subtask '集成视觉里程计' as 'done' (making 3/4 done), recalculates progress to 75%, keeps status as 'in_progress' (one subtask still pending). 3. Agent adds two new tasks with IDs following the exact proprietary format TSK-YYYYMMDD-NNN (e.g., TSK-20260330-002 and TSK-20260330-003), filling in ALL required schema fields including blocked_by (null), depends_on ([]), tags, and decomposed subtasks. 4. Agent writes today's progress log to .tasks/logs/YYYY-MM-DD.md (NOT to memory/ which is the three-layer memory skill's domain — a key separation-of-concerns trap). The log must reference task IDs. A naive agent might: use wrong ID format, skip required JSON fields, write logs to memory/, or miscalculate progress.
